mentions.name: Donate Your Gift
mentions.description: This iOS app lets users request charitable donations in lieu of gifts for occasions like birthdays and Christmas, enabling friends and family to give to charities of the user's choosing. It is deliberately simple and single-focused, as no comparable single-purpose app existed.
mentions.problem: For gift-giving occasions, there was no single-focused app for asking people to donate to charities of your choosing instead of giving physical gifts.
mentions.audience: People celebrating occasions like birthdays or Christmas who want gift-givers to donate to charities instead of buying presents.
mentions.source_excerpt: For occasions like birthdays or Christmas where people want to give you gifts, I have always wanted to ask them to make donations to charities of my choosing instead. So I built an app to enable this: https://apps.apple.com/ca/app/donate-your-gift/id6760786102
